{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Inspect the first few rows to confirm structure
print(df.head())

# Check for sentinel values in customer_age
print('\nNumber of -1 values in customer_age:', (df['customer_age'] == -1).sum())

# Check revenue dtype and look for the 999999.99 QA entries
print('\nRevenue dtype:', df['revenue'].dtype)
print('\nUnique revenue values (first 10):', df['revenue'].unique()[:10])

# Check for refunded orders
print('\nStatus value counts:\n', df['status'].value_counts())"}
